plugins.name: simplemuscle
plugins.description: Design, review, and progress workout plans with exercise data and training history from Simple Muscle.

skills.name: create-plan
skills.description: Creates an approved Simple Muscle plan with one plan write. Use for new plan, routine, split, hypertrophy plan, or strength block.
skills.description_zh: 通过一次计划写入创建已批准的 Simple Muscle 训练计划，适用于新计划、训练安排、分化、增肌或力量训练阶段。

skills.name: program-design
skills.description: Applies training-program principles. Referenced by the other Simple Muscle skills. Use for plan, program, routine, split, progressive overload, hypertrophy, strength, volume, or deload.
skills.description_zh: 提供其他 Simple Muscle 技能引用的训练计划原则，涵盖安排、分化、渐进超负荷、增肌、力量、训练量及减量周。

skills.name: progress-workout
skills.description: Progresses an approved Simple Muscle workout. Use for increase weights, next week, double progression, update sets, or advance my program.
skills.description_zh: 推进已批准的 Simple Muscle 训练，适用于增加重量、下一周安排、双重递进、调整组数或升级训练计划。

skills.name: review-progress
skills.description: Reviews recorded training without editing anything. Use for progress review, adherence, stalled lifts, volume drift, or planning the next block.
skills.description_zh: 只读复核已记录训练，分析进展、执行度、动作停滞、训练量偏移及下一训练阶段规划，不编辑记录。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Verifies Simple Muscle OAuth and workout access. Use for setup, first run, sign in, authorization, or connection problems.
skills.description_zh: 验证 Simple Muscle OAuth 和训练访问权限，适用于初始设置、首次运行、登录授权及连接故障。

skills.name: swap-exercise
skills.description: Replaces an exercise with an approved pattern match. Use for swap exercise, substitute movement, equipment or preference alternative, or pain-free alternative.
skills.description_zh: 按已批准的动作模式匹配替换训练动作，适用于器材或偏好替代、动作交换及无痛替代需求。
